question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is "**Confesion**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The erroneous spelling of the word is '**Confesion**' • Let's look at the correct spelling and meaning of the word. • **Confession**: a formal statement admitting that one is guilty of a crime. • **Example**: *The priest mentioned that it is necessary to do a **confession**__ before the Easter mass* **Hence, the correct answer is option 2** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__** __ • **Confesion **शब्द की गलत वर्तनी है • शब्द की सही वर्तनी और अर्थ • **Confession**: स्वीकारोक्ति • **उदाहरण**: पुजारी ने उल्लेख किया कि ईस्टर मास से पहले एक स्वीकारोक्ति करना आवश्यक है f5:T655, The correct answer is **Constitution**__.
